categories.main_business_segments: Yeal Electric Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the research, development, production, sales, and maintenance of electrical equipment for rail transit vehicles. Its main business includes manufacturing customized electrical components for urban rail vehicles and providing repair services for high-speed trains and metro vehicles. The company also engages in other related businesses such as electronic component sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies including microcomputer control, power electronics, and modular design for its electrical control systems. It employs a flexible, order-driven production model tailored to highly customized products with small batches and short delivery times. Manufacturing processes include precision machining, welding with international standards, and comprehensive quality control supported by digital management platforms. R&D focuses on intelligent, lightweight, and green technologies integrating AI, big data, and IoT.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Yeal's primary customers are domestic rail vehicle manufacturers, notably China CRRC Corporation and its subsidiaries, which account for over 64% of sales. The company serves urban rail transit vehicle manufacturers and operators, including metro and high-speed train sectors. Its products are widely used across 33 cities in China and exported to 13 countries and regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with significant sales in East China, North China, Northeast China, South China, Southwest China, Northwest China, and Central China. It has established subsidiaries and production or maintenance bases in major cities including Changchun, Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Chengdu, Wuhan, Xi'an, Chongqing, and Nanchang, enabling broad regional coverage.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yeal Electric operates primarily in the midstream segment of the rail transit supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and maintenance of electrical equipment for rail vehicles. It supplies key components directly to vehicle manufacturers and provides after-sales and maintenance services, positioning itself as a critical equipment supplier and service provider within the rail transit ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in intelligent, green, and modular rail transit electrical equipment. R&D priorities include platform-based design, lightweight materials, digital and automated production processes, and expansion into new energy and smart sensing technologies such as lithium battery backup systems and intelligent circuit breakers. It also focuses on extending product applications from onboard systems to ground service systems and enhancing maintenance capabilities through digital platforms.
categories.revenue_model: Yeal generates revenue primarily through direct sales of customized rail vehicle electrical equipment and maintenance services. The company operates on a direct sales model, engaging in competitive bidding and contract negotiations with major rail vehicle manufacturers. Additional income is derived from investment returns and government subsidies related to its core business.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yeal is positioned as a leading domestic supplier in the rail transit electrical equipment sector, with strong market share and recognized product reliability. It competes with other specialized rail equipment manufacturers in China, leveraging its long-standing industry experience, extensive customer base, and continuous innovation to maintain competitive advantages. The company is among the few publicly listed firms in this niche, enhancing its brand visibility and market credibility.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Yeal reported consolidated revenues of approximately RMB 471.4 million, marking an 11.29% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 42.3 million, a slight decline of 9.93% due to increased impairment provisions. The company’s total assets reached RMB 1.37 billion, growing 7.43% from the previous year. Cash flow from operations improved significantly, turning positive with RMB 33.8 million. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with ongoing investments in R&D and production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yeal Electric differentiates itself through highly customized, reliable, and technologically advanced rail vehicle electrical equipment tailored to diverse client specifications. Its products emphasize safety, stability, maintainability, and integration of intelligent and green technologies. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, comprehensive quality control, and responsive customer service network provide clients with superior solutions and lifecycle support, fostering high customer loyalty and market recognition.
